verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Figma supports exporting individual layers as SVG (right-click > Copy/Paste as SVG, plus bulk export plugins) and that this is a known part of designer-to-dev workflows, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation describing PNG/SVG/PDF format options, per-layer export presets, custom scales, or slice tooling — the pain points cited (comm-2, comm-3) actually highlight manual, repetitive export as a workflow gap rather than confirm a robust presets/scales system. Missing for 10: first-party docs on export presets UI, scale multipliers, slice tool, and PDF export, plus any independent confirmation of batch/preset export beyond community workaround plugins.
